title: Digging for Wisdom Like Treasure
overview: A parent urges a child to search hard for wisdom, promising that the LORD gives it and that it will guard them from crooked, deceitful men and from a seductive, unfaithful woman.

parts.label: If you search for it (vv. 1-4)
parts.note: The speaker, a parent or teacher, sets out conditions: take these words to heart, listen closely, and call out for understanding. Wisdom has to be hunted with the effort miners put into digging for silver.

parts.label: The LORD gives wisdom (vv. 5-8)
parts.note: The search ends in knowing God, because wisdom is finally his gift, coming from his own mouth. Christians later read this in light of Jesus, whom they see as the place where God's wisdom is stored up.

parts.label: Wisdom settles inside you (vv. 9-11)
parts.note: Once wisdom becomes part of you, doing what is right and fair starts to feel natural, even pleasant. Good judgment then works like a guard watching over you.

parts.label: Rescue from crooked men (vv. 12-15)
parts.note: The first danger is men whose words twist the truth, who leave the straight road for dark ways and take pleasure in doing wrong. Proverbs pictures life as a path, and theirs bends away from what is right.

parts.label: Rescue from the unfaithful woman (vv. 16-19)
parts.note: The Hebrew calls her the strange or foreign woman, here a wife who has broken the marriage promise made before God. Her house leads down to the world of the dead, and scholars debate whether she is only a real person or also a picture of folly itself.

parts.label: Two roads, two endings (vv. 20-22)
parts.note: Those who live rightly will stay in the land, most likely the land of Israel. The wicked will be torn out of it, like a tree pulled up by its roots.

disagreement: Christians differ on whether the chapter's promises of protection and staying in the land are firm guarantees or describe how life generally tends to go for the wise.
think: What is something you have searched for as hard as someone digging for silver, and what made it seem worth the effort?
